title: 🚨 NEW Aircraft Drop! Captain Sim C-130J & 737 MAX 7/8/9 Hit MSFS 2024 Marketplace
description:
For April 18, 2026, this week’s MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update brings some seriously exciting additions for PC simmers — including the must‑have Captain Sim C‑130J Super Hercules along with an entire MScenery Boeing 737 lineup now available in‑sim!

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Captain Sim: C-130J Super Hercules (Legendary tactical military transport aircraft)
🛫 MScenery: 737-600 Professional (Short-haul Boeing workhorse)
🛫 MScenery: 737-700 Professional (Popular narrow-body airliner variant)
🛫 MScenery: 737 MAX 7 Professional (Next-gen efficiency upgrade)
🛫 MScenery: 737 MAX 8 Professional (Modern airline fleet staple)
🛫 MScenery: 737 MAX 9 Professional (Extended capacity MAX variant)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 JED Studio: Boeing C-17A Globemaster III Jeds Livery (Liveries for the C-17A)
🎨 Salt Lake Simulations: 747-400 Retro Livery Pack (Classic airline styles)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777-300ER Maiden Flight Livery (Celebrating first flight look)
🎨 2PILOT: A320V2 NORTH AMERICA LIVERIES (Currently on sale!)
🎨 A2A Simulations: Comanche Livery Pack 1 (Fresh GA paint schemes)
🎨 HRSimYard: H125 US Civilian Livery Pack (Civil helicopter operators)

Thanks for watching and happy flying.
